judgment: It is good to use the law courts.
image: So the early kings made punishments clear
and set the laws in order.
lines: Biting dried meat on the bone —
It is good to hold firm in hardship.

notes.name_en: 噬嗑 is biting and closing the jaws; concrete 'Teeth', not Wilhelm's 'Biting Through'.
notes.L4: 乾胏 dried meat with bone; 金矢 a bronze/metal arrowhead bitten on in it.
